name: redirect-rule-input
title: Redirect Rule Input
description: Stops redirect lists from breaking links, SEO and security: it reads vercel.json, Netlify _redirects or nginx rewrite/return (auto-detected) the way each platform matches, then catches loops and 2+ hop chains with the hop path, rules shadowed by an earlier wildcard, open redirects whose domain comes from the URL, 301/308 on temporary moves, 301/302 turning a POST into a GET, dropped query strings, a ?query or #hash written into the source, missing leading slashes, placeholders the source never captures, trailing-slash traps and hops to http, with a GET/POST URL tester and one-tap fixes (collapse the chain, reorder, make temporary, keep args, match the query separately).
